game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Sandstone Arch Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch, a natural sandstone arch: the caravan guide must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch: a natural sandstone arch
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstone Arch, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about autopsy to power up the caravan guide and open the sandstone arch.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sandstone Arch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Sandstone Arch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
